title: Smart112Recommendation
description: Contract schema for unit recommendation and spatial optimization for incident dispatch.

incident_id.description: Foreign UUID referencing the parent incident.

unit_id.description: Identifier of the unit (UUID or tactical callsign).

type.description: Classification of the unit (AMBULANCE, FIRE_TRUCK, POLICE_PATROL).

distance_km.description: Geodesic or network distance to incident in kilometers.

eta_minutes.description: Estimated time of arrival in minutes.

rationale.description: Tactical justification for recommended response units.
